core_obligations: Work on affine etale charts (proof lines 395-415): let an affine scheme map etale to the space; the restriction of the dualizing complex corresponds to a dualizing complex over the ring by the equivalence of definitions, and the duality functor on the small etale site of that affine scheme is the algebraic duality functor by affine duality; since internal hom commutes with restriction, the commutativity of the displayed diagram shows that the duality functor preserves the category of coherent complexes.

Double duality (proof lines 415-430): the canonical map from a coherent complex into its double dual is an isomorphism because over every affine etale chart it is the corresponding isomorphism for a dualizing complex over a ring.

Boundedness (proof lines 430-440): the exchange of the bounded above and bounded below coherent categories, and hence the equivalence on the bounded coherent category in the quasi-compact case, follow from the corresponding statements for a dualizing complex over a ring.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to affine etale charts and use affine duality.
Transfer coherence and the double duality isomorphism from the charts.
Read off the boundedness statements from the ring case.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a dualizing complex on a locally Noetherian algebraic space is coherent and that the internal hom into it induces an anti-equivalence of the coherent derived category with a canonical double duality isomorphism, exchanging the boundedness properties in the quasi-compact case (statement lines 390-405). The proof (proof lines 406-440) reduces to affine etale charts, uses affine duality and the corresponding statements for a dualizing complex over a ring, and transfers them by compatibility of internal hom with restriction. H3: a chart-by-chart reduction written out in full.
